result.title: MP-MNCA: Morphology-Prior Masked Neighbor Cross-Attention for Efficient Spatial Domain Identification
result.comment: Both authors contributed equally to this work
result.summary: Spatial transcriptomics jointly captures molecular state, tissue morphology, and spatial organization, yet spatial-domain methods are typically compared only at late training checkpoints, obscuring differences in convergence efficiency. We introduce MP-MNCA, a morphology-prior masked neighbor cross-attention framework that preserves the full 3,000 dimensional highly-variable-gene representation while selectively routing molecular information across spatial neighbors, with histological similarity incorporated as a continuous attention prior under a self-supervised masked neighbor-contrastive objective. Across 12 heterogeneous human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) sections, MP-MNCA is evaluated against established spatial-domain baselines using both convergence trajectories and epoch-wise spatial-domain visualizations. Our results show that MP-MNCA (i) reaches coherent spatial-domain structure in substantially fewer training epochs, as reflected quantitatively by convergence curves and qualitatively by progressive spatial grids, and (ii) maintains strong clustering quality, achieving a mean peak refined ARI of 0.546 versus 0.549 for the strongest baseline (STAIG), while attaining the highest mean refined NMI of 0.657 versus 0.640. Moreover, MP-MNCA outperforms STAIG on 7 of 12 sections in ARI and 11 of 12 in NMI, demonstrating faster convergence without sacrificing spatial-domain quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MP-MNCA，一种以组织学形态为连续注意力先验、在空间邻居间选择性路由分子信息的掩码邻居交叉注意力框架，用于空间转录组的空间域识别，并在 12 个 DLPFC 切片上以收敛轨迹与聚类指标同基线比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 用相似度先验做连续注意力偏置、按需路由邻居信息并以掩码邻居对比目标监督，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、注意力结构对 latent 表示的影响及状态更新监督提供可核查线索，但属空间组学远域，迁移可行性待确认。
